Tab badge count for 'En attente' doesn't appear because count=0 (all unpaid are 'partial' status)

action_items: MINOR: InvoicesList 'En attente' tab only shows payment_status='pending' invoices. Consider whether 'partial' invoices should also appear in this tab. Currently 1 'Partiel' invoice (MASSICOT, 1078€) only shows in 'Toutes' tab.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1773 lines — well above 700-line guideline. The new relance scheduler + endpoints are cleanly separated with comments. Future refactor into separate router files would improve maintainability.
The APScheduler skip-Sunday logic uses weekday()==6 (correct for Python datetime). Verified logic is sound.
When a quote is sent via email, relances_active is set to True and relances_sent is reset to [] (line 1461-1462). This is correct behavior.

The run_relances() function sends emails using Resend. It only emails quotes with relances_active=True. The email restriction (only Ruben unless in test mode) should be verified independently — no real emails sent during tests.
toggle-relances endpoint doesn't validate if status is 'sent' — technically any quote can have its relances toggled. This is minor since relances_active only matters for 'sent' quotes.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all critical flows working; 1 minor design note on invoice En attente tab)
